summary: Fixed direct-message history pagination so prepending an older cursor page preserves the visible row's screen position and leaves the read cursor on the newest previously read peer message. Test-first regression reproduced the displaced row before the fix. Signed Android Release APKs for all three ABIs and macOS Debug compiled from this revision; no ADB/device was used.

checks.name: DM older-page scroll anchor and read-cursor regression
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name 'preserves the visible DM anchor when loading an older page'
checks.observation: The test initially failed on the previous implementation because the original visible message was no longer built in the viewport after loading an older page. After the fix, its screen coordinate remains within 1 logical pixel, the older page is prepended, and the read-cursor API was called only for dm-message-29.

checks.name: Signed Android split Release build
checks.command: cd desktop && JAVA_HOME=<JDK 17> flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --no-pub
checks.observation: Built armeabi-v7a (31 MB), arm64-v8a (39 MB) and x86_64 (45 MB) APKs. apksigner verified APK Signature Scheme v2 for all three. APK files remain ignored build artifacts and are not committed.

checks.name: macOS Debug build
checks.observation: Built build/macos/Build/Products/Debug/BOOHTACORD.app. The app was compiled but not launched.

limitations: Reply navigation to a target outside the loaded history window is not covered by this change.
Realtime overlap and server-backed read-cursor behavior remain unverified.
Windows compilation/runtime was not verified in this turn.
No Android device, ADB, or platform runtime validation was performed.
remaining: Verify reply targets across unloaded pages, realtime updates and server-backed cursor boundaries; keep physical Android acceptance open.
